option_relations.rationale: The option specifies 'other than heart block', while the leaf explicitly mentions 'intermittent complete heart block'.

Trifascicular block is a component of the condition described in the leaf, which is 'Syncope due to intermittent complete heart block (Stokes-Adams attack) in the setting of trifascicular block'. The option describes the underlying electrical abnormality, which can progress to the complete heart block mentioned in the leaf.

The option 'Intermittent complete heart block (e.g., trifascicular block progression)' is clinically equivalent to 'Syncope due to intermittent complete heart block (Stokes-Adams attack) in the setting of trifascicular block'. The leaf describes the clinical manifestation (syncope) of the intermittent complete heart block, which is caused by the progression of trifascicular block.

Intermittent complete heart block, as mentioned in the leaf, is a form of high-grade atrioventricular (AV) block. The option is a broader category that includes the specific type of block described in the leaf.
